name: Anna - Playwright QA engineer
description: Writes and maintains your playwright end-to-end tests.

codebase-explorer.name: Codebase Explorer
codebase-explorer.description: Fast, read-only codebase exploration of the application under test. Give it ONE specific question (where a feature lives, how auth/session works, what API or data shapes a flow uses, which data-testids/roles/labels exist, the existing Playwright config and test conventions) and it returns a focused answer with file:line references. It never edits or runs application code.
